title: Can I Apply Night Cream After a Facial? A Simple Timing Guide

quick: Yes, a plain, fragrance-free moisturiser is usually fine the same night after a gentle facial. Pause night creams with kojic acid, vitamin C, retinol or acids for about 24 hours, or 48 to 72 hours after a peel or waxing. Wear sunscreen the next morning.
